game.title: Deus Ex: Human Revolution
game.blurb: First-person action RPG with stealth and hacking, in which Adam Jensen, working for Sarif Industries, uncovers a conspiracy, from Eidos Montreal, released 2011-08-22. RAWG average playtime: 17 hours. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Adam Jensen's investigation across Detroit, Hengsha and beyond. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Side Quests
chapters.summary: Optional jobs for people in Detroit and Hengsha, from a grieving mother to a warrior-priest underground.

chapters.title: Takedowns, Hacking and Stealth
chapters.summary: First takedowns and hacks, knocking out enemies and racking up totals in one playthrough.

chapters.title: Augmentations, Weapons and XP Books
chapters.summary: Upgrading augmentations and weapons, and reading every XP book.

chapters.title: Finishing the Game, Endings and Challenge Runs
chapters.summary: Completing the game, every ending, the hardest setting, no kills and no alarms.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 238010)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Deus_Ex:_Human_Revolution
Fandom (deusex.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://deusex.fandom.com/wiki/Deus_Ex:_Human_Revolution
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 2, but its walkthrough is mostly unwritten: 8 of the 48 mission pages listed in its contents are written (the first three main missions, plus "Getting Out of the Frying Pan", "In the Belly of the Beast", "Choices, Choices", "Acceptable Losses" and "Getting Inside Help" near the end of the list), so it was not used. deusex.fandom.com answers the API, with about 162 linked pages (including "The Missing Link" and "Deus Ex: Human Revolution - Director's Cut"); names only were looked at, nothing copied. The only Steam app in the store list is the Director's Cut (238010), and the achievement text names the Director's Cut; RAWG's first result is the original release (4440), as expected, with a separate Director's Cut entry (3876). 35 of 59 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder. One hidden achievement, "Out of the Frying Pan", shares its name with a StrategyWiki page listed near "The Long Way Home" at the end of the contents, so some hidden ones probably belong to extra content (perhaps The Missing Link) rather than the main story; this needs checking. The ten visible side quest achievements match side mission page names in the StrategyWiki contents.
